title: The lunch packed for the closed lane
body: The lunchbox is wedged beneath the map's fold. The route line passes the checkpoint and stops; a spoon has been laid across the road home.
rival_reading: A field crew might turn back at a restricted checkpoint and leave its meal unopened; the map does not show who set the restriction.
gloss: A meal and a route stop at the same mark.

title: The powder gathered in the bucket seam
body: Pale granules cling inside the bucket's rim. The fertilizer sack beside it is dry and carefully folded, with its open corner tucked under the seat.
rival_reading: Officials could have moved ordinary farm supplies during a road closure; loose granules alone cannot identify a failed program.
gloss: Dry fertilizer and loose granules travelled in one vehicle.
